title: A Survey on Large Language Model based Autonomous Agents
purpose: 建立 Agent 的统一定义、组件框架、应用分类与问题地图。

title: Augmented Language Models: a Survey
purpose: 理解推理、工具与检索如何扩展语言模型，而不是把 Agent 等同于提示词封装。

title: The Rise and Potential of Large Language Model Based Agents: A Survey
purpose: 用另一套分类法交叉检查基础概念，并补充单体与多 Agent 视角。

title: Understanding the Planning of LLM Agents: A Survey
purpose: 掌握任务分解、反馈修正与外部规划器，并映射到视频调查流程。

title: Tool Learning with Large Language Models: A Survey
purpose: 理解工具发现、选择、调用、反馈与错误恢复，形成工业视频工具注册表。

title: A Survey on the Memory Mechanism of Large Language Model based Agents
purpose: 区分短期、长期、情景与语义记忆，指导视频事件记录和证据索引。

title: Survey on Evaluation of LLM-based Agents
purpose: 把成功率、鲁棒性、成本、延迟、可追溯性和安全性转化为可执行实验。

title: LLM-Based Human-Agent Collaboration and Interaction Systems: A Survey
purpose: 设计人工复核、审批、纠错和责任边界，避免以全自动为默认目标。

title: Towards Rationality in Language and Multimodal Agents: A Survey
purpose: 从证据、逻辑、工具、风险控制角度理解可靠 Agent 的技术含量。

title: Large Multimodal Agents: A Survey
purpose: 理解多模态 Agent 的感知、协作与评测结构，建立模型与工具的边界。

title: Video Understanding with Large Language Models: A Survey
purpose: 建立长视频理解的模型、任务、数据集与评测地图，明确工业视频缺口。

title: Ask in Any Modality: A Comprehensive Survey on Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Generation
purpose: 理解跨模态检索、融合、生成与评测，支撑证据化视频问答。

title: Temporal Sentence Grounding in Videos: A Survey and Future Directions
authors: Hao Zhang, Aixin Sun, Wei Jing, Joey Tianyi Zhou
purpose: 掌握文本查询到视频时间片段的定位任务、指标与基线。

title: Large Language Model based Multi-Agents: A Survey of Progress and Challenges
purpose: 仅在单 Agent 难以表达角色边界时查阅，防止过早引入复杂协作。

title: Empowering Real-World: A Survey on the Technology, Practice, and Evaluation of LLM-driven Industry Agents
purpose: 把通用 Agent 能力映射到产业流程、成熟度、治理与行业评测。

title: LLM-based Agentic Reasoning Frameworks: A Survey from Methods to Scenarios
purpose: 对比单 Agent、工具型与多 Agent 推理框架在真实场景中的适用边界。

title: Generalizability of Large Language Model-Based Agents: A Comprehensive Survey
authors: Minxing Zhang, Yi Yang, Roy Xie, Bhuwan Dhingra, Shuyan Zhou, Jian Pei
purpose: 检查研究结论能否跨指令、任务、环境与模型版本成立。

title: ReAct: Synergizing Reasoning and Acting in Language Models
purpose: 复现最小的思考—行动—观察循环，理解框架级贡献。

title: Reflexion: Language Agents with Verbal Reinforcement Learning
purpose: 分析语言反馈和失败记忆何时有效，设计可控的重试机制。

title: Toolformer: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Use Tools
purpose: 理解模型如何学习工具调用位置与参数，并与工程式工具路由对比。

title: ToolLLM: Facilitating Large Language Models to Master 16000+ Real-world APIs
purpose: 参考大规模 API 数据构造、检索和调用评测，不作为暑期复现主线。

title: Generative Agents: Interactive Simulacra of Human Behavior
purpose: 观察记忆流、反思与规划怎样共同产生长期行为。

title: AgentBench: Evaluating LLMs as Agents
purpose: 学习跨环境 Agent 评测设计，并提取任务成功与交互过程指标。

title: WebArena: A Realistic Web Environment for Building Autonomous Agents
purpose: 借鉴真实环境、可复现实验和功能正确性评测的构造方法。

title: OSWorld: Benchmarking Multimodal Agents for Open-Ended Tasks in Real Computer Environments
purpose: 理解开放环境中的多模态观察、动作执行和端到端评测。

title: Video-MME: The First-Ever Comprehensive Evaluation Benchmark of Multi-modal LLMs in Video Analysis
purpose: 参考长短视频、多模态输入与题型覆盖，但不照搬其大规模评测成本。

title: LongVideoBench: A Benchmark for Long-context Interleaved Video-Language Understanding
purpose: 学习长视频上下文、时间定位和跨片段推理的任务设计。

title: DrVideo: Document Retrieval Based Long Video Understanding
purpose: 分析把视频转成可检索文档的收益、信息损失与可复现路径。

title: Video-RAG: Visually-aligned Retrieval-Augmented Long Video Comprehension
purpose: 建立视觉对齐检索的强基线，并寻找工业事件证据组织的差异点。

title: PREGO: Online Mistake Detection in Procedural Egocentric Videos
purpose: 借鉴程序性视频中的步骤建模与错误检测，迁移到工业流程复核。

title: Self-RAG: Learning to Retrieve, Generate, and Critique through Self-Reflection
purpose: 参考按需检索与自我批判机制，重点理解思想而非训练流程。

title: Voyager: An Open-Ended Embodied Agent with Large Language Models
purpose: 用于拓宽持续学习、技能库和自动课程的视野，不作为职业方向预设。
